info.title: CLEVO PHP REST API
info.description: Existing PHP/MySQL marketplace API. All server event times are UTC; civil booking dates/times use BookingTimeZone. Sandbox hosted checkout requires actual provider onboarding; production online payments, stored value and bank settlement are blocked. See PAYMENT_INTEGRATION.md. Decimal money is serialized as strings; legacy numeric IDs may be strings.
